Bullet 3.25 collision/math subset, copied unchanged from upstream commit
`2c204c49e56ed15ec5fcfa71d199ab6d6570b3f5` (tag `3.25`).

Source: https://github.com/bulletphysics/bullet3/tree/3.25/src
License: zlib, see LICENSE.txt and the original notices in each source file.
The local CMakeLists.txt builds a static CPU library; no dynamics, demos,
Python, GPU code or upstream world importer is included in the build.
